blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) is encouraging the youth to speak up and seek assistance when they feel bullied, harassed, or are experiencing problems that may affect their well-being. Seeking help, according to NCRPO, is an important early intervention among concerned institutions to ensure school safety following the recent school-related incidents in the country. READ: PNP eyeing tougher measures, best practices on school safety In a statement on Tuesday, NCRPO chief Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano said that early reporting allows parents, schools, the police, and other professionals to intervene before the issue intensifies. Abrahano also recognized […]...
